what: Continuous tracking of cycles with uncertainty
title: Changes in version 0.6.0
text: New track_ridge_hmm(): continuous tracking one cycle scalogram (wavelet, synchrosqueezed, superlet-SST, ConceFT) hidden Markov model (forward-backward Viterbi): bridges gaps sharp scalograms, gives credible band, confidence curve , period_of_tracked_cycle, sedimentation rate age model uncertainty posterior paths. output works curve2time(). New track_astro_hmm(): astronomically constrained tracking sedimentation rate using cycles together (eccentricity, obliquity, precession; periods weights adjustable deep time), optionally inside rough guide. synthetic tests (2000 kyr, changing sedimentation rate, AR1 noise) age model analyse_superlet_sst() + track_astro_hmm() within 3-20 kyr end record (maximum error 8-25 kyr), 55-120 kyr picking maximum band. track_ridge_hmm() track_astro_hmm() accept jump_depths (known hiatuses abrupt facies changes, abrupt changes sedimentation rate allowed) track_astro_hmm() background = "ar1". Stress tests three jumps sedimentation rate AR1 noise: largest age error 2 % duration (noise half signal), 3-4 % (noise equal signal), 6-9 % (noise twice signal), half error picking strongest power band; noise three times signal rough guide (7 %). high noise credible bands narrow track follows wrong cycle. New track_astro_auto(): recommended workflow one call (scalogram keeps weak cycles, astronomically constrained tracking deep-time periods, optional guide jump depths) plus independent long-window (eCOCO-like) estimate sedimentation rate; intervals two disagree confidence low flagged. stress tests (3000 kyr, three jumps, AR1 noise) largest age error 32-44 kyr (noise half signal), 67-78 kyr (equal), 190 kyr (twice, MSST scalogram); noise three times signal track failed, flags covered 90 % wrong intervals. New astro_periods_tracking(): eccentricity, obliquity precession periods weights age (AstroGeo22 precession constant via astro_terms()) given k, e.g. Silurian/Devonian records; track_astro_hmm() gained age_ma, k_yr, long_weight, local_weight guide_penalty. New plot_track() (show flags). track_astro_hmm(): consistent_cycles = TRUE (default) uses cycles stay inside resolved period range whole sedimentation-rate range (, rates moved cycles range favoured, e.g. ~110-kyr cycle read obliquity eccentricity-Klonk record); track_astro_auto() longer drops 405-kyr cycle top sedimentation-rate range. Tests six real records (ODP 1119; Orcadian Basin 12/13-1; KTG-01; Klonk; Bisciaro; Pod Barrandovem) led : evidence normalised running median along period axis (normalise = "median", removes red-noise bias), cycles outside resolved period range longer favoured, duration argument track_astro_auto() (approximate duration wide prior mean sedimentation rate; without prior tracks often factor ~2 , durations agreed within ~15 % published manual age models 9 12 runs), flags spread posterior (confidence10) instead long-window estimate, time_median (posterior median age) output.

what: Even more wavelets, higher-order and superlet synchrosqueezing
title: Changes in version 0.6.0
text: 11 wavelet families (22 total): exactly zero-mean Morlet ("morlet0"), real Morlet ("morl"), Hermitian hat ("hhat"), Poisson, gammatone, Hann (raised cosine), orthogonal Haar, Daubechies ("db1"-"db20"), Symlets ("sym2"-"sym20") Battle-Lemarie spline wavelets, computed frequency domain filters (Daubechies Symlet filters spectral factorisation). PyWavelets style names ("db4", "sym8", "cgau3", "gaus2", "cmor1.5-1", "shan2-1.5", "fbsp2-1-1.5") accepted, wavelet can user defined function psi_hat(omega). analyse_wavelet_sst(): sst_order = 2 (second-order synchrosqueezing, Oberlin et al. 2015, 2017) corrects instantaneous frequency chirp rate, ridges follow fast changes sedimentation rate also long wavelets; type = "set" (synchroextracting transform, Yu et al. 2017); several omega_nr values give adaptive synchrosqueezing (per position wavelet lowest Renyi entropy, Sheu et al. 2017). analyse_wavelet_sst() also gained n_iter (multisynchrosqueezing, Yu et al. 2019: frequency reassignment repeated) type = "reassign" (reassigned scalogram, Auger Flandrin 1995: power moved period depth/time). New analyse_superlet_sst(): synchrosqueezed transforms wavelets increasing number cycles (default omega_0 = 8, 12, 16; second order, 4 reassignment iterations) combined geometric mean (superlet principle, Moca et al. 2021). synthetic tests (eccentricity-modulated precession obliquity, changing sedimentation rate, AR1 noise) put 75-90 % energy within 3 % true periods, 25-40 % Morlet scalogram, separated 19 23.7 kyr precession bands best. New analyse_conceft(): ConceFT multitaper synchrosqueezing orthonormal generalised Morse wavelets (Daubechies, Wang Wu 2016), method = "multitaper". New sst_significance(): significance synchrosqueezed transforms AR noise (optionally changing variance) simulation settings; non-significant coefficients removed.

what: More wavelets, wavelet agnostic functions, SST defaults, FFT uncertainty
title: Changes in version 0.6.0
text: analyse_wavelet() now offers 11 mother wavelets: Morlet, Paul, DOG (Mexican hat = order 2), Morse, bump, complex Morlet ("cmor"), analytic Gaussian derivative ("cgau"), Shannon, frequency B-spline ("fbsp"), Meyer log-Gabor; aliases ("gabor", "mexh", "ricker", "gmw", "cauchy", …). analyse_Xwavelet(), analyse_wavelet_coherence(), analyse_Awavelet(), analyse_superlet() analyse_Xsuperlet() gained wavelet wavelet_order. adaptive wavelet superlets number cycles converted Morlet equivalent bandwidth chosen wavelet; Morlet results numerically unchanged. analyse_wavelet_sst() works every analytic wavelet (except DOG). Default omega_nr = 12, noise threshold "riskshrink" (universal threshold finest scales), amplitude linear colour levels plots. New fft_frequency_uncertainty() (practical 1/T Heisenberg-Gabor 1/(4 pi T) frequency uncertainty, relative uncertainty) fft_uncertainty() (uncertainty tracked cycle time model, Fourier counterpart wavelet_uncertainty()). Wavelets * analyse_wavelet() new arguments wavelet wavelet_order: besides Morlet wavelet (default, unchanged) Paul, derivative--Gaussian (DOG, e.g. Mexican hat), generalised Morse bump wavelets can used. period axis always Fourier period. reconstruction constant cone influence follow wavelet, extract_signal*(), wavelet_significance() plotting functions work new wavelets. cross-wavelet, coherence Awavelet functions still Morlet . * New analyse_wavelet_sst() (alias analyze_wavelet_sst()): wavelet synchrosqueezing transform (Daubechies et al. 2011; Thakur et al. 2013). result structure analyse_wavelet(), plot_wavelet(), tracking extraction work ; ridges cycles much thinner transform stays invertible. New functions * mesa_spectrum() plot_mesa_spectrum(): maximum entropy spectral analysis (MESA, Burg). Burg recursion base R (identical coefficients stats::ar.burg), AR order chosen FPE, AIC, MDL CAT set hand, one-sided power spectral density variance preserved, peak table prominence. * mesa_evolutive(), track_mesa(), mesa_average() plot_mesa_evolutive(): evolutive MESA one several window lengths (example 30, 40 50 m), padding window top bottom (pad) spectrum spans entire record, peak extraction every window position, dynamic-programming tracking spectral ridge, average amplitude spectrum, spectral-image plot. mesa_spectrum() also accepts single window padding. * test_tuned(), plot_test_k() test_tuned_check(): updated precession-constant test tuned records (version 3). MTM peaks (optionally several proxies pooled) assigned k+s3, k+s6, k+g5, k+g2 k+g4 wide k range (default 19.5-23.5 kyr) instead windows around AstroGeo22, pre-scan removes intervals little precession, ambiguity handling peak assignments, combined k uncertainty, Earth-Moon distance length--day conversion, two tests (spectral peaks, amplitude modulation surrogates). Works better Silurian/Devonian data. British English * WaverideR now uses British spelling primary spelling: analyse_wavelet(), analyse_superlet(), analyse_Awavelet(), analyse_Xwavelet(), analyse_Xsuperlet(), analyse_wavelet_coherence() wr_coloured_noise(). American names (analyze_*, wr_colored_noise()) remain available identical aliases share help page. Arguments American spelling also accept British synonyms (colour_brewer, colour_grid, standardise, centre_limits, normalise); original argument names keep working. Removed (overlap ‘astrochron’) * berger_periods() removed (overlaps astrochron::bergerPeriods()); compare_published() longer contains Berger et al. row data file Berger1989Periods.txt removed. * Hilbert_transform() longer exported; use astrochron::hilbert(). padded internal helper still used extract_amplitude(). Parallel computing * foreach/doSNOW replaced internal base-R parallel helper. Sequential default; run_multicore = TRUE plus new n_cores argument switch parallel . Cores capped (physical cores - 1, max 4, tasks, free RAM, CRAN limit) work done batches incremental combining memory stays bounded. Results reproducible set.seed() independent number cores. * Forked workers Linux/macOS, PSOCK workers Windows RStudio (WaverideR must installed PSOCK workers). Plot windows * New wr_open_device(): Windows-code. Interactive tracking (identify()) works Windows, macOS (XQuartz/Quartz) Linux (X11) gives clear message interactive device available. * dev_new now defaults TRUE RStudio GUI (separate window needed raster plots); override options(waverider.dev_new = ...). Integrated functions * acycle2R functions (astrochronology, Earth-Moon, COCO/eCOCO, etc.), data inst/extdata. * astroMCBchron() modBchron() print/summary/predict/plot methods memory guard. Dependencies * Removed: foreach, doSNOW, DescTools, Hmisc, Matrix, matrixStats, reshape2, truncnorm, colorednoise, trapezoid, fANCOVA, DecomposeR, rlist, RColorBrewer, colorRamps, viridis (base-R replacements). scico magick now optional (Suggests). Fixes * track_ecoco(): new interactive tracker eCOCO results, counterpart track_period(). Plot eCOCO map (pcoco, rho, …), click ridge points (click deselect) get tracked sedimentation rate depth. Points can also given table (points =) scripted, reproducible tracking, result can interpolated windows. * analyze_superlet() checked direct convolution implementation Moca et al. (2021) corrected: (1) default settings order_scaling = "none" multiplied order c1 (o = NULL used order c1 instead 1); (2) order_scaling = "power" used wrong operator precedence "quadratic" documented missing; (3) records non-zero mean trend (typical stratigraphic proxies) gave power longest periods large edge effects, linear trend (mean) now removed record standardised (detrend, standardize; use detrend = "none", standardize = FALSE old behaviour); (4) amplitudes computed sums logarithms (underflow high orders) phases circular means; (5) phase sign convention opposite analyze_wavelet(); (6) new output coi (cone influence) order, warning lowerPeriod Nyquist period. (7) additive cycle rule (mult = FALSE) now checked Moca et al. (2021): -th wavelet c1 + - 1 cycles (c1 + , order 1 differed multiplicative case); additive results change accordingly. * analyze_Xsuperlet(): order_scaling order_alpha passed analyze_superlet(); default upperPeriod/lowerPeriod values swapped; cross spectrum divided period although superlet amplitudes scale dependent; cross phase taken complex geometric mean, whose phase defined (wraps), now difference circular-mean phases. Records now trimmed common, complete part. * New wavelet_significance(): significance levels wavelet superlet scalograms. method = "analytic" instantaneous Torrence Compo (1998) red-noise test (local chi-square levels global spectrum degrees freedom; wavelets ; 4-5 percent false positives simulations Morlet omega 6, 8 10). method = "surrogate" runs noise surrogates transform (wavelets superlets) white, AR(1), signal-corrected AR(1) (candidate periods removed noise estimated) power-law backgrounds, gives scale-wise 95 percent level outside cone influence global spectrum level (Weesp analysis), optionally p-values candidate cycles. Surrogates run several cores results independent number cores. plot_wavelet() plot_superlet() new argument add_signif outline significant cells draw global level. * New wavelet_band_significance(): significance scale-averaged wavelet power (Torrence Compo 1998, section 4d) period band obliquity precession band, white AR(1) background, instantaneous points whole band lies outside cone influence. method = "exact" (default) derives null distribution eigenvalues band-averaged quadratic form, valid omega_nr, dj, band background (checked Monte Carlo 4.6-5.1 percent false positives omega 4, 6, 10 12). method = "torrence" published chi-square form; constant (decorrelation length 0.60) holds omega 6 makes test conservative larger omega (2 percent false positives omega 10), rescaled 0.6 * 6 / omega_nr default. Includes print plot methods. * scalogram plots (plot_wavelet(), plot_Awavelet(), plot_eha_log2(), plot_superlet(), plot_Xwavelet(), plot_Xsuperlet(), plot_wavelet_coherence()) now share one set panel functions (R/plot_wavelet_panels.R) instead 8 16 hand-copied layout branches : seven files shrank 17,700 2,000 lines (plus 400 lines shared panels), colour palette code copied 17 functions one helper. output checked pixel pixel previous version several hundred option combinations (data, average, MTM panels, horizontal/vertical, direction, period limits, lines, points, ablines, p-values, significance contours, arrows); identical except bug fixes . * Plot bug fixes found : color_brewer = "viridis" "colorRamps" failed several plot functions (stray space generated function name); heat.colors, terrain.colors, topo.colors cm.colors palettes failed (start/end arguments); vertical plot_Xwavelet() layout data panel average failed; cross spectrum superlet plots data average panels drew stray y axis global spectrum panel; p-value overlays redrew axes. plot_eha_log2() analyze_wavelet() lost large commented-old copies. * analyze_superlet(): cone influence followed integer order widest wavelet therefore steps; now follows fractional order smooth. wavelets made per frequency instead kept memory, lowers memory use long records, run_multicore/n_cores compute frequencies several cores (identical results). object also stores mult, detrend standardize. * flmw() accepts superlet objects. * plot_superlet(), plot_Xsuperlet() track_period() now shade cone influence superlet objects (coi.1, coi.2), orientations, wavelets. * flmw(): classic method rewritten vectorised code, 50-60 times faster identical output (checked previous version, including run_random = TRUE). old code stopped “missing value TRUE/FALSE needed” spectra; longer happens. New arguments method (“classic”, “weighted”, “template”), tolerance whiten; results gain score_mat best_sedrate. * New flmw_path(): continuity along depth (Viterbi path) posterior probabilities credible intervals, optional sedimentation rate bounds hiatuses. synthetic test (6 cycles, noise equal signal, sedimentation rate changing 3-6 cm/kyr) root mean square error fell 2.0 cm/kyr (classic, best score per depth) 0.15-0.2 cm/kyr (template weighted score plus path). * model_red_noise_wt() computes Morlet wavelets transforms scales one mvfft() call (2 4 times faster, identical output). sum_power_sedrate() rewritten without per-position loops data frames: band limits local maxima computed window maxima come sparse table, 20 times faster identical output (checked several settings). * wavelet_significance(): critical level global spectrum NA (red dashed line stopped) periods without point outside cone influence, global spectrum drawn . analytic level now uses instantaneous level (2 degrees freedom) surrogate level uses points, line continuous whole period range; gws (observed) still NA . * Found plot gallery examples layouts: plot_eha_log2() failed lowerPeriod/upperPeriod given (looked non-existing $Period; now default range object). phase arrows plot_Xwavelet(), plot_Xsuperlet() plot_wavelet_coherence() fixed lengths depth period units (T_unit = 15, P_unit = 0.5), far large short records distorts angle; default now automatic (T_unit = NULL, P_unit = NULL: 0.3 inch whatever record length, screen angle equal phase angle). Colour key labels longer repeat (0.001, 0.001, 0.000) small powers, p-value axis global spectrum longer collides colour key. * analyze_superlet(): left right cone--influence polygons overlapped (darker band, crossing lines) long periods, edge zones wider half record. cone influence now one polygon, whose sides meet middle record like dome wavelet plots (coi unchanged). * plot_astro_anchor(): example used time_dir = FALSE anchor points time increases depth, tie lines crossed one point; now uses time_dir = TRUE (set time_dir = FALSE sections time decreases depth). * New astro_anchor_interactive(): flexible version astro_anchor(). Proxy record astronomical solution shown together peaks; tie points set clicking peak record (either order, place record), removed clicking tied peak , windows can zoomed moved. Proxy record, astronomical solution record tuned current tie points (extracted cycle, astronomical solution sedimentation rate) shown one window, joined numbered tie lines, update tie points made, selected, moved, untied (double click) undone.
